OpenCode Dollar Skills

Type $ in the OpenCode composer to pick a skill — like Codex and Claude Code.

## Requirements - [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 22 or newer. - [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/) V2. The inspected contract was `2.0.6`; newer V2 builds may work but are not certified. - [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/) with Corepack for source installs. ## Install
Install script (recommended) From a published release: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MarlonPassos-git/opencode-dollar-skills/main/install.sh | bash -s -- --release ``` From a clone: ```bash git clone https://github.com/MarlonPassos-git/opencode-dollar-skills.git cd opencode-dollar-skills ./install.sh ``` The script installs globally by default. Pass `--project /path/to/project` to install for a single project and `--upgrade` to replace an existing installation.
Manual commands ```bash corepack enable pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm build node scripts/install.mjs --global ```
Restart OpenCode after installing. Do not also register the same copy in `plugins[]`; the autoload directory is discovered automatically. ## Usage Type `$` in the composer and keep typing to filter. ↑/↓, Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N and Shift+Tab navigate the whole catalog; PgUp/PgDn page through it; Tab or Enter inserts the skill **without sending** the prompt; Esc closes the list. ```text Use $review to review this PR. Use $review-radashi and $tests to review the code and the tests. Use $sds:jira-evidence to build the matrix. ``` Special IDs use brackets (`$[UPPER]`, spaces, Unicode). `$HOME`, `${HOME}`, `$(pwd)`, `R$100`, escaped `\$`, inline code and fenced code blocks are left alone. Hidden and description-less skills still appear; they come from the host catalog as-is. ## Documentation - [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) - [Limitations](docs/LIMITATIONS.md) - [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Testing](docs/TESTING.md) ## Contributing Development and release instructions are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Changes per version are in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). ## License Released under the [MIT license](LICENSE).
